notes: Plans only, each a single cutting a few metres across, so line lengths are 1.4 to 4 m and the arrow error dominates. The report's OCR (tool OCR of PDF pages 42-63, orientation lines suppressed) assigns the structures of RGP 3, RGP 4 and RGP 7 to the Harappa culture of Sub-period IIA. In Figs. 7 and 8 the walls are drawn square to the page and the arrows diagonal, so the walls fold to between +41.5 and +44.5 degrees, next to the folding limit; one wall face in Fig. 8 (room13-north-n) folds to -44.25, the same direction as +45.75, and had to be put in its own system because the 6 degree window uses the folded values. In Fig. 8 the long wall and the north wall of Room 11 (theta +38.3 to +39.2) form a second system. Fig. 10 gives theta -33.0 to -36.8. Taken at face value, the three cuttings disagree by up to about 12 degrees once the folding limit is allowed for; with unspecified, hand-drawn arrows on three small sheets we read this as drafting variation of the arrows rather than a real difference between cuttings.
